newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Photonix names CEO, President.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Photonix names CEO, President.

text.p: Advanced Photonix Inc said on Monday it had named Chairman Hayden Leason as chief executive officer, replacing Robert Allison who was named interim chief executive in October.
Leason remains in the chairman's post in addition to the chief executive officer role. Allison will remain a member of the company's board of directors.
Advanced Photonix also named Harry Melkonian as president replacing Allison in that post.
Earlier, Advanced Photonix reported a net loss of 0.06 per share in its fiscal 1997 second quarter versus a net loss of $0.01 per share one year ago.
